formula: 26 harf: 5 ta unli (a, e, i, o, u) va 21 ta undosh
Qisqa unlilar: a /æ/ cat · e /e/ bed · i /ɪ/ sit · o /ɑ/ hot · u /ʌ/ cup
Magic e: cap → cape · kit → kite · hop → hope · cut → cute
Harf birikmalari: th /θ, ð/ · sh /ʃ/ · ch /tʃ/ · ck /k/ · ph /f/ · wh /w/
examples: x = /ks/ box · j = /dʒ/ job · qu = /kw/ queen · c = /k/ cat yoki /s/ city · y = /j/ yes yoki /aɪ/ my
warnings: oʻzbek harfi ingliz harfi bilan bir xil oʻqilmaydi!

days.title: Kishilik olmoshlari va to be: tasdiq

grammar.topic: Kishilik olmoshlari va to be: tasdiq
formula: I am (I'm) · he / she / it is (he's) · you / we / they are (you're)
examples: I'm Ali. I'm from Uzbekistan. We are friends.
notes: Oʻqish: ee, ea = /iː/ see, tea · oo = /uː/ food, /ʊ/ book
warnings: "Men talabaman" → I am a student (✗ I student)

formula: (−) I'm not · he isn't · you aren't
(?) Am I…? · Is he…? · Are you…?
Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
examples: Are you tired? — No, I'm not.
Is she from Tashkent? — Yes, she is.
notes: Oʻqish: ai, ay = /eɪ/ rain, day · oa, ow = /oʊ/ boat, slow · ou, ow = /aʊ/ house, now
warnings: oʻzbekchada "-mi" qoʻshilgan joyda inglizchada is / are gap boshiga chiqadi.

formula: a + undosh tovush: a car, a university
an + unli tovush: an apple, an hour
examples: I'm a developer. She's an engineer.
notes: Oʻqish: r bilan unlilar (AmE'da r aytiladi): ar /ɑr/ car · er, ir, ur /ɜr/ her, bird, turn · or /ɔr/ for
warnings: oʻzbek tilida artikl yoʻq → ✗ I am developer

formula: I → my · you → your · he → his · she → her · it → its · we → our · they → their
examples: What's your name? — My name is Aziz.
notes: Oʻqish: soqov harflar: kn know · wr write · mb climb · gh night · h hour
warnings: his erkak uchun, her ayol uchun. Oʻzbekchada ikkalasi ham "uning".

days.title: this / that / these / those va koʻplik shakli

grammar.topic: this / that / these / those va koʻplik shakli
formula: this (yaqin, 1 ta) · these (yaqin, koʻp) · that (uzoq, 1 ta) · those (uzoq, koʻp)
+s: book → books · +es: box → boxes · y → ies: city → cities
Notoʻgʻri: man → men · woman → women · child → children · person → people
examples: These are my books. That is my car.
warnings: sondan keyin koʻplik! three books (✗ three book)

phrases.en: How do you say … in English?

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 1-hafta testi: 1–6-kunlardagi formulalar, soʻzlar, diktant, oʻzini 1 daqiqa tanishtirish

formula: Soʻroq soʻzi + am / is / are + ega?
What · Who · Where · How · How old · When
examples: Where are you from? — I'm from Samarkand.
How old is she? — She's twenty.

formula: Ism + 's: Ali's phone · my mother's name
Koʻplikda: my parents' house
Whose + ot + is this?
examples: Whose bag is this? — It's Ali's.

phrases.en: I live on the third floor.

formula: There is + birlik · There are + koʻplik
(−) There isn't · There aren't
(?) Is there…? · Are there…?
examples: There is a bank near my house. There are two parks in my city.
warnings: bu iborada joyda nima borligi aytiladi. Egalik uchun have ishlatiladi (15-kun).

phrases.en: Can you pass me the salt?

formula: in (ichida) · on (ustida) · under (ostida) · next to (yonida) · between (orasida) · behind (orqasida) · in front of (oldida) · near (yaqinida)
examples: The phone is on the table. Where is the bank? — It's next to the park.
warnings: oʻzbekchada "stol ustida" (predlog keyin keladi), inglizchada on the table (predlog oldin keladi).

formula: 0–100: 13 thirteen ↔ 30 thirty
How many + koʻplik ot? · How much is it? — It's $5.
What time is it? — It's seven o'clock. / It's 7:30 (seven thirty).
examples: How many students are there? — There are twelve.
warnings: urgʻuga eʼtibor bering: thirTEEN / THIRty

phrases.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?
Can you show me on the map?

formula: Feʼl (asl shakl): Open the door. Sit down.
(−) Don't + feʼl: Don't talk.
Let's + feʼl: Let's go. · Muloyim qilish uchun please qoʻshiladi
examples: Please close the window. Let's start the lesson.

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 2-hafta testi va 1-haftaning qisqa takrori. Uyingiz va shahringizni 1 daqiqa tasvirlab berish.

days.title: Present Simple: I / you / we / they

grammar.topic: Present Simple: I / you / we / they
formula: Ega + feʼl (asl shakl)
Ishlatilishi: odat, doimiy holat, fakt
have ham shu qoida boʻyicha ishlaydi: I have a car.
examples: I work from home. They live in Tashkent. We study English every day.

formula: he / she / it + feʼl + -s
+es: watch → watches · go → goes · do → does
y → ies: study → studies · have → has
examples: She works in a bank. He goes to the gym.
warnings: ✗ He work. Oʻzbekchada "u" olmoshi bitta, shuning uchun -s koʻp unutiladi.

phrases.en: I'd like a cup of tea.

formula: I / you / we / they + don't + feʼl
he / she / it + doesn't + feʼl (-s qoʻshilmaydi!)
examples: I don't have a car. She doesn't work on Sundays.
warnings: ✗ She doesn't works

phrases.en: What do you do in your free time?
What kind of music do you like?

days.title: Present Simple: soʻroq va qisqa javob

grammar.topic: Present Simple: soʻroq va qisqa javob
formula: Do + I / you / we / they + feʼl?
Does + he / she / it + feʼl?
Yes, I do. / No, I don't. · Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
examples: Do you have a brother? Does he speak English?
warnings: oʻzbekchadagi "-mi" oʻrniga gap boshiga Do / Does qoʻyiladi. ✗ You work here?

phrases.en: What time do you leave home?
Where do you usually go on weekends?
phrases.uz: Dam olish kunlari odatda qayerga borasiz?

formula: Soʻroq soʻzi + do / does + ega + feʼl?
examples: What do you do? (Kasbingiz nima?)
Where does she live? · What time do you get up?

formula: always 100% · usually · often · sometimes · rarely · never 0%
Oddiy feʼldan oldin keladi: I usually get up at 7.
be feʼlidan keyin keladi: She is always late.
How often…? — every day / once a week
examples: How often do you go to the gym? — Three times a week.

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 3-hafta testi. "Mening ish kunim" mavzusida 90 soniya gapirish. Present Simple'ning 4 shakli (+ / − / ? / Wh-) boʻyicha aralash mashq.

formula: at + soat: at 7:00, at noon, at night
on + kun, sana: on Monday, on May 5
in + oy, yil, fasl, kun qismi: in July, in 2026, in summer, in the morning
examples: I get up at 6 in the morning. My birthday is in May.
notes: AmE: on the weekend (Britaniyada: at the weekend)

formula: Ega + can + feʼl (hamma shaxs uchun bir xil, -s qoʻshilmaydi)
(−) can't · (?) Can you…? — Yes, I can.
Ishlatilishi: qobiliyat · ruxsat (Can I…?) · iltimos (Can you help me?)
examples: I can drive. She can't swim. Can I sit here?
notes: AmE talaffuz: can /kən/ qisqa aytiladi · can't /kænt/ choʻziqroq, "t" deyarli eshitilmaydi

phrases.en: Can I ask you a question?

formula: I → me · you → you · he → him · she → her · it → it · we → us · they → them
Feʼl yoki predlogdan keyin keladi
examples: Call me tomorrow. I know him. Look at them.

phrases.en: Do you want to watch a movie?

days.title: like / love / hate + -ing va want to

grammar.topic: like / love / hate + -ing va want to
formula: like / love / hate / enjoy + feʼl + -ing
want + to + feʼl
examples: I like reading. She hates cooking. I want to learn English.
warnings: ✗ I want learn

formula: am / is / are + feʼl + -ing: hozir, ayni paytda boʻlayotgan ish
(−) I'm not working · (?) Are you working?
Imlo: make → making · run → running · study → studying
examples: I'm reading now. They are watching a movie.
notes: Signal soʻzlar: now, right now, at the moment

formula: Simple: odat, har doim · Continuous: hozir, vaqtincha
Holat feʼllari Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi: like, love, want, know, understand, need
examples: I work in an office, but today I'm working from home.
warnings: ✗ I'm knowing → I know

phrases.en: Can you give me some advice?
How much sugar do you want?

days.title: 1-OY IMTIHONI (A1 darvozasi)
days.description: 1–27-kunlar grammatikasi va soʻzlari, diktant, 2 daqiqalik nutq (oʻzi, oilasi, kun tartibi haqida), 80 soʻzli matn. Mezonlar oxirgi sahifada.

formula: Sanaladigan: a book, two books
Sanalmaydigan: water, money, information, music, advice, bread, rice. Ular bilan a / an ishlatilmaydi, koʻplik shakli ham yoʻq.
examples: I need some information.
warnings: ✗ an information, ✗ informations (oʻzbekchada "maʼlumotlar" deyilsa ham)

phrases.en: Do you have this in black?

formula: some tasdiq gapda · any inkor va soʻroq gapda
Taklif va iltimosda some ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea?
examples: I have some friends in Tashkent. I don't have any money. Do you have any questions?

formula: many + sanaladigan koʻplik · much + sanalmaydigan (asosan inkor va soʻroq gapda)
a lot of ikkalasi bilan ham ishlatiladi, asosan tasdiq gapda
How many…? · How much…?
examples: I don't have much time. How many languages do you speak? She has a lot of friends.

phrases.en: Can we have the check, please?

formula: a / an: birinchi marta tilga olinganda, istalgan bitta narsa · the: maʼlum, ikkinchi marta tilga olingan yoki yagona narsa (the sun)
Artiklsiz: umumiy maʼno, masalan I like music.
examples: I have a dog. The dog is very big.
notes: Iboralar: go to work · at home · go to school

phrases.en: There were a lot of people.
I was born in a small village.

formula: I / he / she / it + was · you / we / they + were
(−) wasn't / weren't · (?) Was she…? Were you…?
There was / There were
examples: I was at home yesterday. Were you tired? — Yes, I was.
notes: Vaqt soʻzlari: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020

formula: Feʼl + ed (hamma shaxs uchun bir xil)
Imlo: live → lived · study → studied · stop → stopped · play → played
examples: I worked yesterday. She studied English last night.

phrases.en: Where did you go on vacation?
I took a lot of photos.

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 5-hafta testi va 1-oyning qisqa takrori. Doʻkonda xarid qilish dialogi.

formula: Feʼlning 2-shakli yod olinadi (Ilovadagi 1–25-feʼllar)
go → went · have → had · see → saw · do → did · make → made
examples: I went to Samarkand last year. We had dinner at a restaurant.

phrases.en: How do you get to work?
I didn't take the bus, I walked.
Did you have a good flight?

formula: (−) didn't + feʼl (asl shakl)
(?) Did + ega + feʼl? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
examples: I didn't go to work. Did you see the movie?
warnings: ✗ I didn't went

days.title: Past Simple: Wh- savollar va hikoya qilish

grammar.topic: Past Simple: Wh- savollar va hikoya qilish
formula: Soʻroq soʻzi + did + ega + feʼl?
Hikoya bogʻlovchilari: first, then, after that, finally
Notoʻgʻri feʼllar: 26–40
examples: Where did you go? What did you do yesterday?
First I got up, then I had breakfast…

phrases.en: Don't forget to bring your passport.
I like it, but it's expensive.
I stayed home because I was sick.
Can you bring me some water?
phrases.uz: Menga ozgina suv olib kela olasizmi?

formula: and (qoʻshish) · but (qarama-qarshilik) · or (tanlov) · because (sabab) · so (natija)
examples: I was tired, so I went to bed. I stayed home because it was cold.

formula: Sifat ot oldida keladi (a big house) yoki be dan keyin (The house is big). Sifat koʻplikda oʻzgarmaydi.
Ravish: sifat + ly (slow → slowly) · notoʻgʻri: good → well · fast → fast · hard → hard
Notoʻgʻri feʼllar: 41–60
examples: She speaks English well. Drive slowly!
warnings: ✗ bigs houses

phrases.en: A horse is bigger than a dog.

formula: Qisqa sifat + er than: cheap → cheaper · big → bigger · easy → easier
Uzun sifat: more + sifat + than: more expensive
Notoʻgʻri: good → better · bad → worse · far → farther
examples: Tashkent is bigger than Samarkand. English is easier than Chinese.

phrases.en: It's the biggest city in the country.
Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in the world.
phrases.uz: Samarqand dunyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri.

phrases.en: It's the best place to visit.
phrases.uz: Bu borib koʻrish uchun eng yaxshi joy.

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 6-hafta testi va notoʻgʻri feʼllar testi (60 ta). "Mening oʻtgan dam olish kunim" mavzusida 2 daqiqa gapirish.

formula: the + qisqa sifat + est: the cheapest · the biggest · the easiest
the most + uzun sifat: the most beautiful
Notoʻgʻri: the best · the worst
examples: This is the best day of my life. Who is the tallest in your family?

phrases.en: I'm going to get a job.
What are you going to do this summer?
We're going to move to Tashkent.
My dream is to study abroad.

formula: am / is / are + going to + feʼl
Ishlatilishi: oldindan qilingan reja · koʻrinib turgan bashorat
(−) I'm not going to… · (?) Are you going to…?
examples: I'm going to visit my parents on the weekend. Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.
notes: AmE: ogʻzaki nutqda gonna boʻlib eshitiladi, lekin shunday yozilmaydi

phrases.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
I promise I won't be late.

formula: will + feʼl (hamma shaxs uchun bir xil)
Ishlatilishi: shu zahoti qilingan qaror · fikr va bashorat · vaʼda
(−) won't · (?) Will you…?
Reja oldindan qilingan boʻlsa going to, qaror hozir qilinsa will
examples: I'll call you later. I think it will be sunny tomorrow. I won't forget.

phrases.en: You have to wear a seatbelt.

formula: have to / has to + feʼl: majburiyat · don't have to: shart emas
must + feʼl: qatʼiy qoida · mustn't: taqiq
examples: I have to work tomorrow. You must wear a seatbelt. You mustn't smoke here.
warnings: don't have to (shart emas) ≠ mustn't (mumkin emas)

phrases.en: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.

formula: should / shouldn't + feʼl: maslahat
Can you…? / Could you…? (muloyimroq): iltimos
Can I…? / Could I…?: ruxsat soʻrash
examples: You should sleep more. Could you help me, please?

phrases.en: I'd like to book a room.
Could you help me with my bags?

formula: I'd like + ot · I'd like to + feʼl
Would you like…? — Yes, please. / No, thank you.
Let's… · Why don't we…?
examples: I'd like a coffee, please. I'd like to book a table. Would you like to join us?

phrases.en: Have you ever been to Dubai?

days.title: TAKRORLASH KUNI
days.description: 7-hafta testi. Kafe va doʻkon dialoglari. "Mening keyingi oydagi rejalarim" mavzusida 2 daqiqa gapirish.

formula: have / has + feʼlning 3-shakli (worked, been, seen, eaten)
ever soʻroq gapda · never inkor maʼnoda
Qisqartma: I've · she's
examples: Have you ever been to Dubai? I've never eaten sushi. She has visited London twice.

formula: Present Perfect: tajriba, vaqti aytilmaydi
Past Simple: aniq vaqt bor (yesterday, last year, in 2020)
examples: I've been to Samarkand. I went there last summer.
warnings: ✗ I have been there last summer

formula: [Soʻroq soʻzi] + yordamchi feʼl + ega + asosiy feʼl?
Yordamchilar: am / is / are · do / does · did · can · will · have / has
examples: Where do you work? · Where did you work? · Where will you work? · Have you ever worked abroad?

phrases.en: When I get home, I'll call you.
phrases.uz: Uyga yetib borganimda, sizga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.

phrases.en: Before I go to bed, I read.
After work, I go to the gym.

days.title: Gap tartibi va vaqt ergash gaplari

grammar.topic: Gap tartibi va vaqt ergash gaplari
formula: Ega + Feʼl + Toʻldiruvchi + Joy + Vaqt
when / before / after + gap
examples: I study English at home every morning. When I get home, I cook dinner.
warnings: oʻzbekchada vaqt odatda gap boshida keladi, inglizchada esa odatda oxirida

phrases.en: I'm working on a new project.
I've worked here for two years.
phrases.uz: Bu yerda ikki yildan beri ishlayman.

formula: Present Simple: odat · Present Continuous: hozir · Past Simple: oʻtgan · going to / will: kelajak · Present Perfect: tajriba
Aralash mashq: bitta mavzu, 5 ta zamon
examples: I usually… / Now I'm… / Yesterday I… / Tomorrow I'm going to… / I've never…

phrases.en: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
Is there an ATM near here?

formula: Xatolar daftaridagi eng koʻp takrorlangan 10 ta xato ustida ishlash
Cambridge A2 Key uslubidagi namunaviy mashqlar

days.title: 2-OY IMTIHONI (A2 darvozasi)
days.description: 1–55-kunlar: grammatika, soʻzlar, tinglash, 3 daqiqalik nutq, 120 soʻzli matn. Mezonlar keyingi sahifada.
